name: Gol'dir
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details: From what I can tell of the documents you procured, Gol'dir is being held in a large Syndicate base to the north, most likely in the Alterac Mountains. He has been held captive far too long and must be freed.
narrative.objectives: Free Gol'dir then return to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
narrative.offerRewardText:
Thank you, adventurer. I led the expedition from Durotar under the Warchief's orders, but as you can see, our plans went somewhat awry. They have held me captive here in this town, forcing me to work, hauling burdens, digging...

What I have suffered is unimportant, however. There is important information you must deliver to whomever is leading our group now.
narrative.requestItemsText: Give me the key, Champion, I will undo the lock myself.
narrative.endText: Find where Gol'dir is being held

chain.subtitle: 6 quests from level 22 to 42, 18,000 XP in all.

quests.name: The Rescue
quests.objectiveText: Krusk in Tarren Mill needs you to free Drull and Tog'thar from Durnholde Keep.

quests.name: Infiltration
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve information about Gol'dir's whereabouts for Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Gol'dir
quests.objectiveText: Free Gol'dir then return to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Blackmoore's Legacy
quests.objectiveText: Return the information gathered by Gol'dir to Krusk in Tarren Mill.

quests.name: Lord Aliden Perenolde
quests.objectiveText: Kill Lord Aliden Perenolde and ask his mistress, Elysa, about Taretha's pendant.

quests.name: Taretha's Gift
quests.objectiveText: Return Taretha's pendant to Krusk in Tarren Mill.
